land.text: the Gobir kingdom round Alkalawa on the Gulbin Rima, the Sokoto country

successors.note: "The state was then partially absorbed into Sokoto"; the Gobirawa resisted in the north-east under Sarki Ali dan Yakubu and Sarki Mayaki, built a capital at Tibiri near Maradi in 1836 and survive as non-sovereign monarchies in Nigeria and Niger. The Maradi country is not handed to Sokoto: the court kept it (Tibiri 1836).

wars.name: Gobir and the jihad of Usman dan Fodio

zones.text: the Gobir kingdom round Alkalawa on the Gulbin Rima, the Sokoto country

wars.outcome: Yunfa exiled dan Fodio from Degel in 1803; the jihad began on 21 February 1804 with some initial Gobir successes (Tsuntua); Alkalawa fell on 3 October 1808 and Yunfa was killed.

wars.name: Gobir expansion and raids
wars.outcome: Around 1715 Gobir aided Zamfara's revolt against Kebbi; in the mid-18th century Soba attacked Katsina, besieged Zarma for three years, raided Gurma and Ilorin; Babari raided Katsina, Kano and Katagum.
wars.note: No lasting border change is described.

certainty.note: No frontier on the page; the capital moved six times and the state was a mobile core with raided neighbours.

sources.title: Gobir

sources.title: Tibiri
sources.note: Tibiri founded in 1836 under Mayaki as the new capital of the Gobir State replacing Alkalawa; French rule a few years after 1899 (fix af-03-x). The page named Tibiri_(Maradi) does not exist.

notes:
Sultanate of Gobir, additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Page: Gobir (1 page).

Conflicts on the page: Birnin Lalle 1450-1600 (infobox) versus "early 18th century" (text); the ruler table (Bawa Jan Gwarzo 1777-1795) versus 1777-1790 and Nafata 1801-1803 versus "r. 1797-98"; Birnin Zamfara's destruction c. 1756 or 1762. No area, no frontier: the keyframes are admin-1 proxies for the capitals of each period, and the 1150-1449 Agadez disc overlaps the Sultanate of Agadez (1405+). The rulers strip is not given (the table is inconsistent). The Gobir state after 1808 (Tibiri 1836, Sabon Birni 1853, the rump states) is not in this dossier.
Counterparts: Zamfara (no dossier), sokoto-caliphate (exists). Gazetteer: Birnin Lalle, Goran Rami, Alkalawa, Degel, Tibiri (places).

Revised 2026-10-19 after the review (verdict fail): (a) The 1756-1808 shape is Maradi plus Sokoto (the 1756 gain), so Gobir's country no longer vanishes; the 1808 loss to Sokoto takes the Sokoto country only and a new 1808 loss cp nobody (c1) releases Maradi, because the page keeps the court in the north-east (Tibiri 1836) while the infobox ends the state in 1808. The rump state at Tibiri (1836 to French rule shortly after 1899; Sabon Birnin Dan Halima 1853) is NOT followed: no page dates its end, and it is listed as a gap. (b) The Aïr shape ends in 1404 and a loss 1405 cp sultanate-of-agadez (c1) is added (Gobir page: Agadez set up 'early in the 15th century, replacing Gobir as the dominant power'); the Maradi country is drawn from 1405 instead of 1450 so that no year is empty, at confidence 1; the infobox keeps Asben as capital to 1450 and an unnamed court (Birnin Lalle proxy) fills 1405-1449. The sultanate-of-agadez dossier (verdict pass, not touched) founds Agadez in 1405 with counterpart nobody; its owner may name sultanate-of-gobir. (c) The Tibiri (Maradi) page proposed by the reviewer does not exist; the Tibiri page was read instead and gives only the 1836 founding.
